billboard_index.note: McGill Billboard Project index (song metadata, no keys).
billboard_index.citation: Aljanaki, Margoni, Muller. Studying Popular Music Composition with the McGill Billboard Dataset. ISMIR 2016.

billboard_lab.note: 890 songs, LAB chord annotations (Harte syntax, includes inversions and chord embellishments).
billboard_lab.citation: Aljanaki, Margoni, Muller. Studying Popular Music Composition with the McGill Billboard Dataset. ISMIR 2016.

isophonics_beatles.note: Beatles reference annotations: chordlab + keylab + seglab LAB files (Harte). No formal license text; distributed openly for research. Only aggregate counts are redistributed.
isophonics_beatles.citation: Mauch et al. A Correction to the Beatles Dataset. ISMIR 2011.

isophonics_queen.note: Queen reference annotations: chordlab + keylab LAB files (Harte). Only aggregate counts are redistributed.
isophonics_queen.citation: Zanetti et al. A Fighter's Guide to Computational Music Analysis: Queen. ISMIR 2017.

isophonics_mj.note: Michael Jackson reference annotations: chordlab + keylab LAB files (Harte). Only aggregate counts are redistributed. Bundle turned out to contain only segmentation (seglab) files - no chords/keys published - so it is NOT used as a data source.
isophonics_mj.citation: Mauch et al. The Michael Jackson pop corpus. ISMIR 2010.

isophonics_caroleking.note: Carole King reference annotations: chordlab + keylab LAB files (Harte). Only aggregate counts are redistributed.
isophonics_caroleking.citation: Mauch et al. A correction to the McGill Billboard dataset: Carole King. 2015.

wjazzd.note: Weimar Jazz Database v2.1 SQLite: 456 jazz solos / 302 tunes, chord label per beat (beats.chord), composition-level tonality. ODbL share-alike honoured by attributing and only redistributing aggregate counts.
wjazzd.citation: Arndt, Pfleiderer, Muller. The Weimar Jazz Database. 2017.

nottingham.license: GPL-3.0 (cleaning); original Nottingham Music Database is free/community
nottingham.note: 1034 ABC lead sheets (melody + chords) with K: key fields. Chord notation normalised by JukeDeck. Used as read-only input; only aggregate counts are redistributed.
nottingham.citation: Nottingham Music Database (abc.sourceforge.net/NMD/); cleaned by JukeDeck Ltd.

tavern.note: 27 Mozart/Beethoven theme-and-variation sets, 1060 phrases, Humdrum .krn Roman-numeral analyses (**chords spine + **function).
tavern.citation: Deevy, Devaney. TAVERN: Theme And Variation Encodings with Roman Numerals. 2020.

chordonomicon.reason: NonCommercial license; excluded by project decision.

when_in_rome.reason: No repository license; it republishes third-party corpora of mixed licensing.

augmentednet.reason: MIT, but checked-in data is only 199 MuseScore correction zips; its corpora are unlicensed/NC submodules. Dropped as data source (TAVERN covers classical).
